summary: NaaS Technology Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Beijing-based EV-charging services company listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a routine current report) containing Exhibit 99.1, its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. No transaction, stakeholder action, or corporate event is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary periodic earnings/interim-results submission. Figures show total assets of RMB 292.7 million against total liabilities of RMB 1,183.1 million, negative equity of RMB 890.3 million, and first-half revenue of RMB 45.5 million. Nothing here is actionable for a special-situations or risk-arbitrage read.
